name: Maintenance Issues
description: Eventually, your ship needs a tune-up, or sometimes a complete overhaul. When this happens, you’ll need to get it repaired. Minor Repairs cover cosmetic damage, cleanup, and other handyman type work that can be handled by the crew while the ship is in flight. Minor Repairs take roughly [[/r 2d10]] days. Major Repairs cover large scale structural or system damage, including repairing Megadamage and Hull. Major Repairs can only be fixed in port.
